info.description: High-performance, fault-tolerant catalog synchronization engine with SQLite multi-tenancy, real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE), and dead-letter quarantine resolution.
info.title: Resilient Catalog Synchronization Engine API

post.description: Clears all products, jobs, checkpoints, and dead-letter issues for the specified tenant. Blocked if a job is active.

409.description: Cannot reset database while a job is running

get.description: Returns paginated dead-letter records with filtering by job ID and quarantine reason.

400.description: Invalid limit, offset, or shop ID

post.description: Remediates an invalid dead-letter record and imports the corrected product into the catalog.

200.description: Product resolved and imported to catalog

400.description: Validation error (invalid price, status, or timestamp)

get.description: Establishes a persistent Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection streaming real-time job progress, status changes, dead-letter notifications, and catalog version events (version_created, version_rollback).
Returns a paginated list of catalog synchronization jobs, with optional status filtering.

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 20, min 1)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter by job status (PENDING, RUNNING, INTERRUPTED, COMPLETED, FAILED)
parameters.name: status

400.description: Invalid limit, offset, or status filter

post.description: Initiates a catalog synchronization job in background. Supports synthetic data generation ("generator") or direct batch ingestion ("batches").

202.description: Synchronization job accepted and running in background

400.description: Invalid request payload, invalid ratios, or invalid shop ID

409.description: A synchronization job is already running for this tenant

get.description: Retrieves full status and checkpoint audit history for a specific synchronization job.

200.description: Job metadata and committed batch checkpoints

400.description: Missing job ID or invalid request

post.description: Sends a cancellation signal to stop a currently running synchronization job.

400.description: Missing job ID or invalid request

404.description: Job not currently running or active

post.description: Resumes an interrupted catalog synchronization job from its last committed checkpoint.

parameters.description: Optional generator parameters to override on resumption
parameters.name: request

202.description: Job successfully resumed and executing in background

400.description: Missing job ID, malformed body, or invalid config

409.description: Job already running or already completed

get.description: Computes aggregated synchronization performance metrics, quality score, and matching sync runs.

parameters.description: Time preset (today, yesterday, 7d, last7days, all, custom) default 'today'
parameters.name: time_range

parameters.description: Filter metrics by specific Job ID
parameters.name: job_id

200.description: Aggregated metrics and matching sync jobs

400.description: Invalid time_range, date format, or shop ID

post.description: Performs an immutable, dry-run in-memory projection of a sparse catalog patch without database writes, validating invariants and returning projected item deltas, checksum, and quarantined issues.

parameters.description: Catalog patch payload containing sparse item updates
parameters.name: request

200.description: Dry-run simulation diff preview and invariant checks

400.description: Malformed JSON, empty items, or invalid shop ID

500.description: Failed to snapshot catalog or internal server error

post.description: Commits a validated catalog patch atomically to the live catalog, journals pre-image deltas, creates a new PATCH milestone version, and broadcasts real-time SSE notification. Blocked if dead-letter issues are detected.

parameters.description: Catalog patch payload containing sparse item updates
parameters.name: request

201.description: Version published successfully with recorded item deltas

400.description: Malformed JSON, empty author/description/items, or invalid shop ID

422.description: Patch commit blocked due to quarantined dead letters or invariant violations

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of catalog products, with optional status filtering and text search.

parameters.description: Filter by product status (ACTIVE or WITHDRAWN)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Search substring in SKU or product name
parameters.name: search

400.description: Invalid limit, offset, status, or shop ID

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of catalog version milestones with summary counts and author metadata, ordered newest first.

parameters.description: Maximum versions to return (default 20, min 1, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Invalid limit, offset, or shop ID

get.description: Retrieves all item-level pre-image deltas (previous and new prices, names, and statuses) associated with a specific catalog version milestone.

200.description: Array of pre-image item deltas recorded for the version

400.description: Missing version ID in URL path or invalid shop ID

post.description: Reconstructs baseline catalog state at target version, calculates inverse deltas preserving tombstones (Invariant A), updates live catalog, generates a forward ROLLBACK version milestone, and broadcasts real-time SSE notification.

parameters.description: Target Catalog Version ID to revert to
parameters.name: id

200.description: Catalog reverted successfully with new forward version and deltas

400.description: Missing version ID in URL path, malformed request body, or invalid shop ID

message.example: product resolved and imported to catalog

description.example: Rollback due to supplier pricing error
